{{Quote|According to the priest, the gems are ''living entities''&hellip; Life forms from another part of the cosmos swept here by the cataclysm that created the Red Nebula. They're ''mates'' of sorts. As long as they are ''together'', they radiate a sense of well being, a positive ''physical aura''&mdash;an aura that can affect their ''surroundings''. Separated, their well being turns to ''anguish'' and the aura turns ''negative'', radiating stronger&hellip; ''growing''&hellip;|[[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]]|<ref name="SW50" />}}
The '''Great Life Jewels''' were a pair of [[Gemstone/Legends|gems]] that appeared in the [[Red Nebula/Legends|Red Nebula]] after the [[Awesome cataclysm|cataclysm]] that separated it from the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Together, they had the power to preserve life within their proximity; however, once separated, they carried a [[Death/Legends|fatal]] [[Disease/Legends|disease]] known as the [[Crimson Forever]].
